post_title: What will Rosstat's preliminary estimate of Russia's Q3 2026 GDP growth (year-on-year) be?

question.title: What will Rosstat's preliminary estimate of Russia's Q3 2026 GDP growth (year-on-year) be?
question.description:
Rosstat publishes a preliminary ('предварительная') estimate of quarterly GDP roughly 45 days after each quarter ends; it is based on operational statistical reporting from large and medium-sized non-financial enterprises and excludes statistical information from the DNR, LNR, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions. The Q3 2026 estimate is scheduled for Friday 13 November 2026.

Recent official prints (year-on-year change in the physical volume index of GDP): 2025 full year +1.0%; Q3 2025 +0.6% (index 100.6% — this is the base for the Q3 2026 comparison, published 14 November 2025); Q1 2026 -0.2% (index 99.8%); Q2 2026 +1.3% (index 101.3%, first published 12 August 2026 and confirmed at 1.3% on 11 September 2026); H1 2026 +0.6%.

Momentum indicators point to a gradual recovery from the weak first quarter. MinEkonomiki's monthly GDP estimates were +0.6% y/y in July, +0.8% in August and +0.5% in September 2026. Industrial production was +0.4% y/y in July, -0.6% in August and +1.8% in September (+0.2% over January–September). On 9 October 2026 Central Bank deputy governor Alexei Zabotkin said preliminary September data point to faster growth in Q3 than in H1 and that the economy has likely passed its trough. The Bank of Russia's 2026 growth forecast is 0.0–1.0%; MinEkonomiki's is 0.6%; the IMF's October 2026 forecast is 0.9%. The HSE 'Centre of Development' quarterly consensus survey (14–25 August 2026) put Q3 2026 real GDP growth at +0.6% y/y.

An important caveat for forecasters: Rosstat's preliminary quarterly prints have recently come in above monthly-indicator-based estimates — the Q2 2026 preliminary of 1.3% compared with 0.8% (CBR) and 0.9% (MinEkonomiki). Rosstat reports this index to one decimal place, and the same-day release (13 November 2026) also includes the October consumer price index (September 2026 CPI was +0.35% m/m with annual inflation at 6.35%).

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the year-on-year real GDP growth rate for Q3 2026 published in Rosstat's release 'Справка о предварительной оценке динамики ВВП в III квартале 2026 года', scheduled by Rosstat for 13 November 2026 (publication calendar: https://rosstat.gov.ru/announcements; the document itself appears in the 'Срочные информации и справки' section: https://rosstat.gov.ru/compendium/document/50798). The resolved value is the reported 'индекс физического объема валового внутреннего продукта в III квартале 2026 г. относительно соответствующего периода 2025 г.' minus 100, in percentage points: e.g. a reported index of 99.8% resolves as -0.2, and an index of 101.3% resolves as 1.3. If Rosstat's Q3 2026 preliminary figure is instead first published in a different Rosstat document on or after 12 November 2026, that first published figure governs. Rosstat's later revisions of the Q3 2026 figure (e.g. the 'первая оценка' due in December 2026) do not affect resolution.
question.fine_print: If Rosstat reports the result directly as a growth rate rather than as an index (e.g. '-0.2% г/г'), that reported growth rate is used as the value. If the linked Rosstat pages are unavailable, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) reporting the same Rosstat release will be used.
